notes:
Inbound self-serve signup from solo founder (Jae Kim). No AE touch yet — PLG motion.

Snapshot:
- Signed up for free tier on 2025-01-18, verified email, started issuing API calls from prototype VS Code extension.
- Primary workload: code-assistant plugin (completion + few-shot), secondary: embeddings for snippet search across ~8k repo snippets.
- Early metrics: ~1k tokens/day first week, spike to 3.5k tokens/day on 2025-01-30 after a user demo.
- Tried OpenAI (gpt-3.5) during prototyping; quoted: "great quality but cost adds up; need predictable per-token economics". Interested in Redwood hosted API because of batching + cost controls.

Technical / requirements notes:
- Wants quick public-cloud onboarding (likely us-east1). No VPC or on-prem.
- Latency target: interactive editor feel, P95 < 300ms for completions ~64-128 tokens.
- Throughput: low steady, occasional bursts when users demo (10-50 rps for 30s).
- Model preference: open quantized model acceptable if latency/cost tradeoff is good.
- Routing/fallback: basic fallback to smaller model on overload; owner curious about automatic variant routing.
- Security: developer wants audit logs, API key rotation, and retention controls but not enterprise SSO yet.

Engagement timeline:
- 2025-01-18: user signed up via landing page (referral from tweet).
- 2025-01-19: automated welcome email + quickstart link sent.
- 2025-01-22: in-app error spike (rate limit), auto-alert created -> INF-2241. Support reply same day with rate-limit tweak suggestions.
- 2025-01-31: recorded demo call (Fireflies ff_20250131_1382). Jae asked about cost projections and burst capacity.
- 2025-02-01: follow-up email with cost calculator and starter SDK snippets (js/py) — positive reply, asked about TL;DR on billing.

Open items / Next steps (CRM shorthand):
- Send 1-page TL;DR on billing thresholds + soft limits (DONE draft; attach pricing-v1.pdf).
- Add short example for prefix/KV caching in SDK (to reduce tokens).
- Monitor usage for upgrade trigger (~10k tokens/day sustained) and flag for AE handoff.

Notes about conversion likelihood: small but promising; founder is cost-sensitive and product-led. If 2-3 customers show sustained usage, they'll commit to monthly paid plan.

Other refs: small repo with prototype (GitHub link sent on call; internal note).
